children: Portugal's government said on Friday it had decided to take rivals Air France-KLM
to a final round of negotiations, asking both groups to submit improved offers for a minority stake in flag carrier TAP.

Both European airline groups submitted binding offers in July, the terms of which were not disclosed, to buy a 44.9% stake in TAP and become its strategic partner. The government said those offers were "globally very similar".
